observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a white and blue sewing/embroidery machine resting on a patterned bedspread.
The word "brother" is clearly printed on the front panel of the machine in both photos.
A small LCD screen on the right side shows a colourful pattern preview, consistent with an embroidery function.
No model number (e.g. SE630) is legible on the body or screen in either photo.
No power cable, foot pedal, embroidery hoop, or accessory kit is visible in either photo.
No photo shows the machine powered on, stitching, or any test fabric/sample output.
The user-supplied statement 'The brand is Singer' is contradicted by the visible 'brother' logo on the machine itself; photo evidence overrides this text.
